DELETE /accounts/booking/{booking_id}.description: Cancels an active booking, clearing the engineer's dwell and calendar hold so the slot's capacity returns to availability. Rescheduling is not supported in v1 -- customers book a new slot instead.

schema.description: Payload for cancelling an active booking. v1 supports cancellation only -- automated reschedule is out of scope; customers book a new slot instead.

booking.description: A scheduled customer-support voice callback. Never exposes which engineer was assigned -- the customer only ever sees a time.

case_id.description: Linked Salesforce case id. A booking is never confirmed without a case attached.

category.description: Support category/problem summary. Customers select this from the create-case flow. The server uses the configured eligibility mapping to resolve it to a skill group, determine available engineers, and decide whether to offer scheduling.

channel.description: The support channel for the booking. v1 supports voice callbacks only; engineers manually dial customers at the scheduled time.

customer_phone.description: Customer contact number for the callback, captured at booking time and validated against the selected country code. This directly addresses wrong/international phone numbers (notably EMEA/APJC) that were a top pain point with the prior ad-hoc callback feature.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code selected from the country-code dropdown, defaulting to the country inferred from account locale. Used to validate and format phone_number.

phone_number.description: Phone number in national format, validated against country_code.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of a booking.

GET /accounts/booking/availability.description: Returns believable, bookable callback slots on demand for the authenticated account from live WFM roster, Calendar free/busy, and post-call dwell signals. Slots are derived, not pre-generated -- this call persists nothing. Emergency categories and non-contract or otherwise ineligible accounts never receive slots.

parameters.description: Support category selected in the create-case flow. Used to resolve the eligible skill group(s) via the configured eligibility mapping; categories classified as emergency/incident severity are never offered slots and route to the existing immediate phone/incident path instead.
parameters.name: category

schema.description: Support category/problem summary. Customers select this from the create-case flow. The server uses the configured eligibility mapping to resolve it to a skill group, determine available engineers, and decide whether to offer scheduling.

parameters.description: IANA timezone identifier used to compute and render slot times in the customer's local time.
parameters.name: timezone

200.description: Believable slots for the requested category and timezone.

slots.description: Believable slots for the requested category and timezone, or an empty array if engineers lack availability in the requested window.

items.description: A single callback time that Chronos offers to a customer. Chronos computes each slot on demand from live WFM roster, Calendar free/busy, and post-call dwell signals; it never pre-generates or persists them, so customers see only believable, bookable times. The response never names the engineer who takes the call.

slot_token.description: Opaque, short-lived token identifying this candidate slot and the engineer holding it. Clients pass this token in CreateBookingRequest to atomically claim the slot. If another booking claims the slot first, the API returns 409 and clients must re-fetch availability.

start_time.description: Start of the slot (RFC 3339, UTC). Render in the timezone supplied on the availability request.

POST /accounts/booking.description: Creates a voice callback for the authenticated account against a slot previously returned by GET .../booking/availability.

schema.description: Payload for hard-assigning a voice callback against a slot that GET .../booking/availability previously returned.
